population.rule: every export candidate whose reconciled verdict is flagged

ruling_text.equivalent-electron: rename with the word equivalent_electron next to the base; waiting on the grammar release, not attempted this pass
ruling_text.shared wording:species: the density counts ions summed over all positive charge states, with neutral atoms excluded
ruling_text.shared wording:operator: the flux surface average is the average of a quantity over a closed magnetic flux surface weighted by the inverse magnitude of the poloidal flux gradient
ruling_text.operator: the name gains the omitted average, integral, weighting or normalisation where the DD source is the averaged or weighted quantity
ruling_text.family parent: regenerate the definition to state one quantity where one exists; a parent that is only a grouping is held from the cut
ruling_text.unit misfit: the name is regenerated to match the definition and the unit, preferring an operator or qualifier the grammar already has
ruling_text.single object or mechanism: sn edit with the readers' phrase as the priority reason; the pipeline and review settle the spelling and may decline with a recorded reason
